basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old outdoor enthusiast from Oregon, USA. Recently took up fly fishing and fly tying as a way to unwind from my day job in IT support. I love learning new skills, especially ones that let me connect with nature. Typically online in the evenings and weekends. Single, with two cats who sometimes make appearances in my posts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT and technology, mostly self-taught through online courses and hands-on experience. Recently, I began exploring the world of fly tying through YouTube tutorials and community threads. My interest in ArcoLinux stems from my love for customization and open-source software.
